domain: public procurement - tender-level outcome prediction (desertion), Chile
prediction_question: A Chilean public-sector tender (licitación) is published on Mercado Público. At the publication instant, given only publication-time context - the buying organism and its unit (CL-RUT identifier, region, municipality), tender title and description, item list with UNSPSC categories and quantities, estimated value and currency, procedure type (L1/LE/LP/LQ/LR public by UTM band, E2/CO/B2/H2/I2 private, LS specialised services), convocatoria type, payment/duration terms and the publication calendar position - will the process end deserted (desierta: no valid bids, Ley 19.886 art. 3 or 9) rather than adjudicated?
prediction_time: The instant the tender is published on Mercado Público (tender publication date; OCDS release date). Everything decided or observed after publication is excluded from shipped features: the closing act, bids received and their counts, the evaluation, the adjudication/revocation decision and award documents, and contract fields. The OCDS award-stage status fields are the label source and are excluded from shipped columns. Construction note: a tender document fetched for a closed month carries the tender's final status/statusDetails (e.g. '5-Publicada' vs closed states) - construction must reconstruct publication-time state from publication-stage fields only.
target_definition: Binary: the process's OCDS award status is 'unsuccessful' with statusDetails vocabulary '7-Desierta (o art. 3 ó 9 Ley 19.886)' (positive) vs 'active' / '8-Adjudicada' (negative). Measured on the first-100 samples of closed months: 17/98 = 17.3% desertion (2019-06), 14/98 = 14.3% (2023-06); cancelled/revoked ('15-Revocada', ~2-3%) are excluded from the scored population at construction with the exclusion recorded. Label source columns: award release status/statusDetails (+ tender final status as cross-check); excluded from shipped feature columns.

Puede copiar, modificar, distribuir e interpretar la obra, incluso para propósitos comerciales, sin pedir permiso.'

Publisher's own terms (chilecompra.cl/terminos-y-condiciones/, fetched 2026-10-21): 'La plataforma de Datos Abiertos, a disposición del público en general a través del Sistema de Información, contiene la información de las compras públicas realizadas a través de dicho sistema, en formatos que facilitan su análisis, monitoreo y fiscalización, así como la reutilización de la información para el desarrollo de nuevos informes o aplicaciones.' - reuse explicitly contemplated by the publisher for its open-data platform.

Statutory context (chilecompra.cl/datos-abiertos/, fetched 2026-10-21): 'Con las modificaciones a la Ley de Compras Públicas, que entran en vigencia el 12 de diciembre de 2024, la normativa indica que deberá encontrarse disponible a través de formatos de datos abiertos y reutilizables toda la información que los organismos del Estado publiquen en el sistema de información y gestión.'

Channels checked that carry NO licence statement (all measured 2026-10-21, per the licence-posture procedure): the datos-abiertos React app bundle (3.1 MB main.b731c6dc.js grepped case-insensitively for licencia/términos/creative commons - no match, so no licence text renders on any site page); the OCDS list API metadata (no licence field); the publisher publication-policy URL recorded by the OCP registry (api.mercadopublico.cl/APISOCDS/Utilidades/Politicas/Actualizacion -> HTTP 404); the national harvest catalogue datos.gob.cl (CKAN package_search q=chilecompra -> count 0); the Política de Gobierno de Datos PDF (Res. Exenta 143-B/2024 - internal staff data-governance rules only, no public licensing deed). LICENCE DECISION: redistribution permitted - CC0 recorded for this publication by the standard's registry, plus publisher terms that explicitly contemplate reuse, plus a statutory open-formats mandate. Residual question recorded honestly: no licence deed appears on the publisher's own web surfaces; a one-time written enquiry to ChileCompra (noting the CC0 registry record, asking for preferred attribution wording) is a pre-construction confirmation step, not a blocker. Source terms preserved; our derived compilation dedicated CC0 per standing policy; derived, never presented as the publisher's official product.

construction_script: candidates/chilecompra-tender-outcome/source/build.py (construction only) + score.py (simple references, runs only after acceptance) + run.sh (build -> qualify -> accept exact bytes -> references); bundle assembled by scripts/assemble-job.py from source/bundle.json
split_strategy: temporal by tender publication month, same calendar months one year apart: train 2019-05..2019-06, eval 2020-05..2020-06, holdout 2021-05..2021-06. Membership = the month of the FIRST tender release; the award release is read afterwards only to compute the label.

measurements.award_outcome_samples_2026_10_21: probe_desertion.py, first 100 processes of each closed month: 2019-06 award statuses: active 78 (79.6%), unsuccessful 17 (17.3%), cancelled 3 (3.1%), 2 processes without urlAward; 2023-06: active 78 (79.6%), unsuccessful 14 (14.3%), cancelled 2 + '15-Revocada' 2 (4.0%), 1 with empty status, 2 without urlAward. statusDetails vocabulary observed: '7-Desierta (o art. 3 ó 9 Ley 19.886)', '8-Adjudicada', '15-Revocada'.
measurements.monthly_totals_2026_10_21: listaOCDSAgnoMes pagination.total (licitaciones stream): 2010-01: 33,366; 2014-01: 22,218; 2018-01: 13,049; 2020-01: 11,661; 2023-01: 11,382; 2025-01: 7,785. Declining volumes over time - window sizing must use per-month counts, not a single year's.
measurements.bulk_zip_series_2026_10_21: ocds.blob.core.windows.net/ocds/{yyyymm}.zip: present 2009-01..2022-04 (2022-05 -> 404, clean Azure XML error). Ranged-GET sizes: 201001 377,010,777 B; 201406 948,139,521 B; 201806 613,891,953 B; 201906 1,131,029,693 B. PANEL BYTES = ESTIMATE: ~160 months x 0.38-1.13 GB ~= 100-150 GB compressed JSON - worker-scale only, streamed per month, bytes never through the coordinator.
measurements.doc_sizes_2026_10_21: tender docs avg 100,620 B (2019-06, n=5) / 31,987 B (2023-06, n=5); award docs avg 11,418 B / 8,488 B (n=98 each). API throughput measured ~1 request/s (214 requests, 209 s) - full-panel per-process API fetching infeasible; bulk zips are the channel.
measurements.cost_measured: Discovery cost: 214 requests / 2.67 MB / 209 s for the award samples (probe_desertion.py), plus ~30 ranged HEAD/GET probes for bulk sizes, month totals and zip verification. Construction cost on the worker: 160 zip downloads (~100-150 GB, ESTIMATE from 4 measured month sizes) + per-month stream extraction; trivial for a Hetzner worker with adequate disk.
measurements.release_history_vintage_2026_10_23: Measured from the bytes before choosing cohorts: the 2016 bulk zips were rebuilt at migration (blob Last-Modified 2020-03) and carry a SINGLE release stamped 2018-12-31 with tender.status='complete' and the final text - i.e. the compiled state, not a publication snapshot. The 2019/2020/2021 zips carry a genuine progressive history (sampled 201906 n=12, 202101 n=18: first release equals tenderPeriod.startDate within 0-1 days, status 'active', 3-7 tenderUpdate releases, status moving active->complete at closing). Construction therefore requires the first release's tender.status == 'active' and buckets anything else as publication_state_not_evidenced (2/12/14 rows). No 2016-cohort task was built.
measurements.references_2026_10_23: Simple references on the accepted eval rows (all fitted on train only): procedure_only 0.5164, region_only 0.5309, unspsc_only 0.5673, calendar_only (buyer_region x pub_month) 0.5270, value_procedure 0.5410. Constant train rate 0.176962 has no ranking information (AUC unmeasured). Majority-class accuracy 0.8332 on 11,943 eval rows. These are single-feature conditional-rate references, not a model: no full-model baseline has run yet, so no headroom claim exists.
measurements.prevalence_shift_2026_10_23: Positive rate by split: train 0.1770 (2019-05/06), eval 0.1668 (2020-05/06), holdout 0.2512 (2021-05/06). The holdout is an out-of-distribution window as well as a temporal one; any model comparison must be read per split, not pooled.

novelty_check.theirs: The publisher ships the raw OCDS data (monthly bulk zips 2009-01..2022-04 + real-time API; OCP registry mirrors per-year JSONL/CSV 2022+) but no prediction task, splits or scoring. Research prior art on other labels/countries: TenderKG (French tenders 2021-2023, bidder-recommendation KG benchmark, FigShare); UniTo/ANAC Italy ML papers (tender contract-variation prediction, 96.5% XGBoost); 'Failed Procurements as a Measure of Public Procurement Performance' (Springer 2026, TED/CAN void-rate empirical analysis, no ML task); MiDES (Brazilian municipal procurement raw tables, descriptive desertion rates).
novelty_check.ours: First scored, temporally-split prediction task on ChileCompra Mercado Publico licitaciones: at tender publication, predict whether the process will be declared deserted (desierta, Ley 19.886 art. 3/9) at adjudication, from publication-time features only (buyer, region, UNSPSC items, estimated value, procedure type, publication calendar), over the 2009-2022 monthly OCDS bulk panel with train/eval/holdout windows and a runner-compatible binary contract. No prior art ships this task: existing procurement-ML work predicts other labels (contract variations, bidder recommendation) on other countries.
novelty_check.rule: A dataset that already exists in ML-ready form is not published. Mirroring is a failure mode, not a contribution.
